steps.action: Upload a new Document steps 1-4: Documents tab, Upload, Choose files with one file, Kind, Note, Upload
steps.expected: One file creates a Document named from its filename with a v1 row; Kind offers the six hand-set kinds
steps.actual: Upload document dialog opened with Choose files, Kind and Note. Kind offered Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Amendment, Executed; no Generated redline. After Upload the list held one row "doc029-draft-v1.docx" (from the filename) showing v1, Draft · ours and the note.

steps.action: Upload step 2 variant: choosing several files opens the bulk import dialog
steps.expected: The Import dialog replaces the one-file composer; Cancel creates nothing
steps.actual: Two chosen files opened the Import 2 files dialog instead of the composer. Cancel closed it and the record still held one Document.

steps.action: Upload step 4: Actions menu, Edit details, Save changes the name and description
steps.expected: Name and description change; the Version chain is untouched
steps.actual: Edit details saved the name "DOC-029r2 Admin supply draft 140665" and a description. Read-back: still one Version, v1.

steps.action: Add another Version steps 1-3: Add version, Choose file, Kind, Note, Upload; expand and read the earlier Version
steps.expected: The Version number increases; the earlier Version stays readable with its note, author and bytes
steps.actual: Add version dialog showed Choose file, Kind and Note; after Upload the row read v2. Expanding the chain listed doc029-draft-v1.docx; selecting it opened the reader "DOC-029r2 Admin supply draft 140665, version 1" with the v1 chip visible. Download returned the original v1 bytes (SHA-256 match). v1 kept its note, kind, filename and uploader.

steps.action: History note: uploading the same paper as a new Document creates a separate chain
steps.expected: A second Document appears; the first chain is not merged or changed
steps.actual: The same file uploaded again made a second Document "doc029-draft-v1.docx" at v1; the first Document still had two Versions.

steps.action: Correct the Kind control on an existing hand-set Version
steps.expected: The kind changes; bytes and Executed pin do not; Generated redline is not offered
steps.actual: The Kind control on v2 offered Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Amendment, Executed. Choosing Redline · theirs saved (read-back kind redline_theirs); no Executed pin was set by the change; the v2 download still answered 200.

steps.action: Executed pin: Mark as executed copy on an earlier Version; a later upload does not move it; Unmark clears it
steps.expected: The pin stays on the earlier Version after a newer Version arrives
steps.actual: Mark as executed copy on version 1 set the pin there. A v3 upload left the pin on v1. Unmark as executed copy on v1 cleared the pin.

steps.action: Primary Document: the Primary mark and Make primary move the designation
steps.expected: Primary moves to the other Document
steps.actual: "DOC-029r2 Admin supply draft 140665" carried the Primary mark and its menu had no Make primary. Make primary on "doc029-draft-v1.docx" moved the mark there (read-back isPrimary). The designation was then moved back for the next checks.

steps.action: A Matter upload has no Kind control, and a Matter has no Primary mark or Executed pin
steps.expected: No Kind column or composer Kind, no Make primary or Mark as executed copy
steps.actual: The Matter Upload document dialog had no Kind control and the list had no Kind column or Kind correction. The row menu offered Add version, Edit details, Move to folder, Mark confidential, Archive, Delete: no Make primary and no Mark as executed copy. On an Entity the Document row had no Primary mark and its menu offered Add version, Edit details, Move to folder, Mark confidential, Archive, Delete.

steps.action: Before you start: an archived owning record must be restored before uploading
steps.expected: The archived record offers no Upload; restoring brings it back; the seam refuses an upload meanwhile
steps.actual: While the Contract was archived its Documents section showed no Upload button and a direct upload answered 409 (This contract is archived. Restore it before uploading.). After restoring the Contract the Upload button returned.

steps.action: Recover from a refusal: a failed upload shows a message and does not alter the chain
steps.expected: An upload message appears; the Version count stays the same
steps.actual: With a browser-network fixture answering 413 for the Version upload, the Add version dialog stayed open with the message "DOC-029 fixture: this file is larger than the upload limit.". The Document still had 3 Versions.

steps.action: File a Contract conversation attachment steps 1-4: File to Contract, New Document, Confidential preselected for Legal Only
steps.expected: A Legal Only attachment files as a new Confidential Document and the comment reads Filed to
steps.actual: The attachment offered File to Contract. File attachment opened with Destination New Document and "Confidential — restrict to the contract team" already on, plus Document name and Kind. File created "DOC-029r2 Admin filed paper 140665" (Confidential, one Version) and the comment read "Filed to DOC-029r2 Admin filed paper 140665, version 1".

steps.action: File a Contract conversation attachment: open the preview, File to Contract, New Version on an existing Document with a Note
steps.expected: The preview offers the same action; the Version is appended with its note
steps.actual: Selecting the attachment name opened its preview with Download and File to Contract. Choosing New Version on an existing Document, Document "DOC-029r2 Admin supply draft 140665" and a Note appended v4 with that note; the comment read "Filed to DOC-029r2 Admin supply draft 140665, version 4".

steps.action: File a Matter conversation attachment: File to Matter, no Kind, same Confidential switch label
steps.expected: The Matter offers File to Matter without Kind; filing creates a Matter Document
steps.actual: The Matter attachment offered File to Matter. File attachment had no Kind control and the switch read "Confidential — restrict to the contract team". File created the Matter Document.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders steps 1-2: New folder, Name, Save; an empty folder has no expand control
steps.expected: The folder row appears without an expand control
steps.actual: New folder opened a dialog with Name and Save. The "DOC-029r2 Admin Parent" row appeared reading "DOC-029r2 Admin Parent Empty" with no expand control.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 3: New subfolder and Rename from Actions for the … folder
steps.expected: The subfolder is created inside; the parent gains an expand control; Rename changes the name
steps.actual: New subfolder opened "New folder in DOC-029r2 Admin Parent"; the child appeared under the now-open parent (Collapse DOC-029r2 Admin Parent control present). Rename folder changed "DOC-029r2 Admin Child draft" to "DOC-029r2 Admin Child". Read-back: the child's parent is DOC-029r2 Admin Parent.

steps.action: Folder name rules: case-only duplicate sibling, blank name, slash, '.' and '..' are refused
steps.expected: Each attempt shows a refusal and creates nothing
steps.actual: All five names were refused in the dialog and no folder was created. "DOC-029R2 ADMIN PARENT": A folder named DOC-029R2 ADMIN PARENT is already here.; "   ": Give the folder a name.; "DOC-029 a/b": A folder name cannot contain a slash. Make a folder inside instead.; ".": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder.; "..": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder..

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 3: Move, Move into, None; a folder cannot move into itself or a descendant
steps.expected: Move into omits the folder and its descendant, the seam refuses a cycle, and None returns a folder to the top level
steps.actual: Move into for "DOC-029r2 Admin Parent" offered None, DOC-029r2 Admin Other: not the folder itself or its child. The seam refused a move into its own child (409: A folder cannot be moved inside itself.) and into itself (409). Moving "DOC-029r2 Admin Child" into "DOC-029r2 Admin Other" read back as DOC-029r2 Admin Other/DOC-029r2 Admin Child; Move into None put it at the top level.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: Move to folder, File in, Move; None moves it out
steps.expected: The Document is filed in the folder and then moved back to the record
steps.actual: Move to folder opened "Move doc029-admin-loose-a.txt" with File in; choosing "DOC-029r2 Admin Parent" filed the Document there and the folder gained an expand control showing it. File in None moved it back onto the record.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: drag a Document row onto a folder row, then onto Drop here to move out of folders
steps.expected: Dragging files the Document into the folder and back out
steps.actual: Dragging the "doc029-admin-loose-b.txt" row onto the "DOC-029r2 Admin Other" folder row filed it there (read-back). Dragging it from inside the folder showed "Drop here to move out of folders"; dropping on it moved the Document back to the record.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: select checkboxes and Move in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both selected Documents move into the chosen folder
steps.actual: Selecting both checkboxes showed "2 selected" with Move. The Move 2 documents dialog with File in "DOC-029r2 Admin Parent" filed both Documents there (read-back).

steps.action: Folder Delete dissolves the folder: contents move to its parent or the record, nothing is deleted
steps.expected: The confirmation says where contents go; the Documents stay live on the record
steps.actual: The confirmation read "Delete the DOC-029r2 Admin Parent folder? Anything in it moves onto the contract itself. Nothing is deleted. Cancel Delete". After Delete the folder was gone and both Documents were live at the record root.

steps.action: Import several files steps 1-5 with a partial failure: Destination Record root, Version kind, counts, Retry
steps.expected: The good files stay as v1 Documents, the failed row is named with Retry, and Retry sends only the failed file
steps.actual: Choose files with three files opened "Import 3 files" showing Destination Record root and Version kind ("Applied to every file in this import. Notes are not collected in bulk."). With a browser-network fixture answering 503 once for one file, the dialog read "Imported 2 of 3 files 2 of 3 files uploaded doc029-bulk-c.txt DOC-029 fixture: the upload service is unavailable. Retry doc029-bulk-a.txt Done doc029-bulk-b.txt Done 1 file failed. The other 2 are on the contract. Retry uploads the selected file again. Files o" with a row Retry and Retry 1 file. The two good files were already v1 Documents (Draft · theirs). Row Retry sent only the failed file and the dialog closed; the record gained exactly 3 Documents.

steps.action: Recover a partial import: a size refusal is not offered a retry; Done closes
steps.expected: The failed row has no Retry, and the good file remains
steps.actual: With a fixture answering 413 for one file, the dialog read "Imported 1 of 2 files 1 of 2 files uploaded doc029-bulk-d.txt DOC-029 fixture: this file is larger than the upload limit. doc029-bulk-a.txt Done 1 file failed. The other 1 is on the contract. Retry uploads the selected f" and offered no Retry control. Done closed it; the other file was on the record.

steps.action: Import step 5: when every file uploads the dialog closes after the list refreshes
steps.expected: The dialog closes by itself and both files are listed
steps.actual: A two-file import with no failure closed the dialog by itself; the record gained two Documents.

steps.action: Recover a partial import: Cancel remaining stops queued work and uploaded files remain
steps.expected: Queued files are cancelled; the finished uploads stay on the record; final counts are shown
steps.actual: With uploads slowed by a fixture, the running dialog said "Keep this dialog open until the import finishes." Cancel remaining settled it at "Imported 3 of 5 files": 2 file(s) read "Cancelled before it was uploaded." and the 3 uploaded file(s) were on the record (read-back +3).

steps.action: Keep a local folder structure: Choose folder keeps nested paths; the folder picker drops empty folders; a matching path is reused
steps.expected: The top-level folder and its nested child are created with their files; the empty folder is not; a second import reuses the path
steps.actual: Choose folder on a local tree (two files, one nested folder, one empty folder) opened "Import 2 files" reading "Import 2 files Destination Record root Folder structure is kept doc029-tree-140665 1 folder · 2 files sub-a 1 file doc029-nested.txt 23 byte doc029-top.txt 20 byte Version kind Draft · ours Draft · th". The import created doc029-tree-140665 and doc029-tree-140665/sub-a with the files; the empty folder was not created. Importing the same tree again reused the existing doc029-tree-140665 folder (still one).

steps.action: Import step 1-2 and Keep structure: drop files and a local folder on a folder row; the Destination is that folder; a dropped tree recreates empty folders
steps.expected: The Import dialog names the folder as Destination and the empty folder is recreated
steps.actual: Dropping the local tree on the "DOC-029r2 Admin Other" row opened a dialog reading "Import 2 files Destination DOC-029r2 Admin Other Folder structure is kept doc029-tree-140665 2 folders · 2 files empty-dir Empty sub-a 1 file doc029-nested.txt 23 byte doc029-top.txt 20 byte Version k". The import created DOC-029r2 Admin Other/doc029-tree-140665/sub-a and the empty DOC-029r2 Admin Other/doc029-tree-140665/empty-dir.

steps.action: Import step 3: a Matter import has no Version kind control
steps.expected: The Matter batch dialog shows Destination but no Version kind
steps.actual: On a Matter, Choose files with two files opened Import 2 files with Destination Record root and no Version kind control.

steps.action: Read a managed Document steps 1-4 (PDF): name opens the reader; v… indicator; Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in, Find in document; Download; Close the document
steps.expected: The reader shows the title and v1, the PDF controls work, Download returns the original bytes, and Close returns to the record
steps.actual: Selecting "admin-doc029-services-text.pdf" opened the reader "admin-doc029-services-text.pdf, version 1" with the v1 chip and Page 1 of 2. Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in and Find in document were present; Next page reached Page 2 of 2 and Previous page returned. Find for a word in the text layer read "1 of 2". Download returned the uploaded bytes (SHA-256 match). Close the document closed the reader.

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: Word and PowerPoint render as a PDF rendition; Download stays the uploaded file; a preview is not a new Version
steps.expected: Both open in the PDF reader after preparation and download the original bytes; the chain stays at one Version
steps.actual: admin-doc029-draft-v1.docx: rendition ready, PDF reader pages shown, download matched the uploaded file; admin-doc029-deck.pptx: rendition ready, PDF reader pages shown, download matched the uploaded file. Each chain still had one Version.

steps.action: Processing, scans: an image-only PDF stays a scan; Find has no match; OCR text arrives in the background; global search finds it
steps.expected: Reader Find reports no match, text read-back source is OCR, and global search lists the Document
steps.actual: The scan opened as Page 1 of 1 in the reader and Find in document for "Marrowbridge" read "No matches". The text read-back became ready from source ocr and contained the word. Global search for "Marrowbridge" listed "admin-doc029-scan.pdf".

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: PNG shows inline; EML shows headers, body and attachment list without remote images; a PDF attachment previews; a Word attachment downloads
steps.expected: Image inline; email headers and 2 attachments; no remote image request; PDF attachment opens; DOCX attachment is a download
steps.actual: The PNG drew as an inline image. The EML reader showed From, To, Subject, Date, the sandboxed "Message body" text and "2 attachments"; the body's remote image (src "") made no request to the remote host. The PDF attachment opened in a preview with "Back to the message"; the Word attachment was a download link and returned its bytes. Reading the email created no new Documents.

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: other formats download from the name; a reader link shows the download-only card
steps.expected: CSV and ZIP names download directly; a reader link to one shows the card
steps.actual: Selecting "admin-doc029-schedule.csv" and "admin-doc029-bundle.zip" downloaded the original files (SHA-256 match) without opening a reader (0 -> 0 panels). Opening the CSV through a reader link showed "This file type does not open here. Download it to read it." with Download.

steps.action: Processing: Preparing this document for reading… while conversion is pending; the stored original is already downloadable
steps.expected: The pending message shows and Download returns the uploaded file
steps.actual: With a browser-network fixture holding the rendition read at pending, the reader showed "Preparing this document for reading…" and Download returned the uploaded Word file (SHA-256 match).

steps.action: Failed previews: the failure message, Download of the original, and recovery by adding a readable Version
steps.expected: A damaged Word file shows the failure card and downloads; a new Version renders while the failed Version stays in the chain
steps.actual: The malformed Word container reached rendition state failed. The reader showed "This file could not be prepared for reading here. Download it to read it." and Download returned the original bytes. Add version with a readable Word file made v2 (rendition ready), which opened in the PDF reader; expanding the chain and selecting the v1 filename still showed the failure card for v1.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 1: Documents from navigation; Recent shows up to five Documents by current-Version upload, not by opening
steps.expected: Recent lists at most five, in the order of the newest current Versions, and opening an older Document does not change it
steps.actual: The Documents navigation link opened the repository. Recent listed 5 Documents in the same order as the newest-current-Version read (repo-autodoc-admin-140665.docx, repo-knowledge-admin-140665.pdf, …). After opening the older "repo-folder-admin-140665.docx" and returning, Recent still matched the upload-time order and did not add it.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 2: Filter, Owner, Contracts/Matters/Entities/Auto-Docs/Knowledge, Apply
steps.expected: Owner offers the five kinds and each narrows to paper of that owner kind
steps.actual: Owner offered Contracts, Matters, Entities, Auto-Docs, Knowledge. Contracts: 50 rows, including repo-root-admin-140665.pdf; Matters: 50 rows, including repo-matter-admin-140665.pdf; Entities: 50 rows, including repo-entity-admin-140665.pdf; Knowledge: 16 rows, including repo-knowledge-admin-140665.pdf; Auto-Docs: 1 rows, including repo-autodoc-admin-140665.docx. Each list left out the fixture paper of the other owner kinds.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 3: Record with Search choices; Folder becomes available with Record root
steps.expected: Record narrows to one Contract; Folder picks the folder or Record root
steps.actual: Record with Search choices "C-63" narrowed the list to the Contract's 4 live Documents, and the Filter menu then offered Folder. Folder "DOC-029r2 Admin Repo folder" showed only "repo-folder-admin-140665.docx"; Record root showed the Documents outside folders. With Owner Knowledge, and with Owner Auto-Docs, the Filter menu offered no Folder.

steps.action: Search and narrow steps 4-5: Format and Uploader accept several values; different filters must all match; Uploaded From/To includes both dates; remove one filter and Clear all; Recent hides while filtered
steps.expected: Any-of within a filter, all-of across filters, inclusive dates, and Recent only without filters
steps.actual: On C-63, Format PDF + Word ("Matches any selected value") kept the PDF and the Word Document. Kind Draft · ours left out "repo-root-admin-140665.pdf", whose v1 is Draft · ours but whose current v2 is Draft · theirs. Kind Executed left only "repo-folder-admin-140665.docx"; Counterparty DOC-029r2 Admin Northwind 140665 and Uploader Daniel Okafor kept it. Uploaded From 2026-09-16 To 2026-09-16 ("Includes both dates") kept it; From 2026-09-17 showed "No documents match these filters.". Removing the Kind filter left the list empty; removing Uploaded widened it again. Recent was hidden while filters were active and returned after Clear all.

steps.action: Open the matching paper: selecting the name opens the owning record with the current Version; expand the chain for an earlier round
steps.expected: The record opens with the reader on v2 and the chain lists v1
steps.actual: Selecting "repo-root-admin-140665.pdf" opened C-63's Documents tab with the reader on "repo-root-admin-140665.pdf, version 2". Expanding the chain and selecting the earlier filename opened version 1.

steps.action: Missing or archived: a hidden record's Document does not appear through a filter or direct link
steps.expected: An Administrator reaches every Contract, so the Confidential Contract's paper is listed
steps.actual: As Administrator, Record choices for C-62 offered "DOC-029r2 documents hidden owner 140665", the repository read listed its Document, and the record's Documents read answered 200. The article does not claim that an Administrator is refused.

steps.action: Missing or archived: Filter, Show archived includes archived Documents; the offered Restore brings one back
steps.expected: The archived row appears with Archived and Restore; Restore makes it live
steps.actual: After archiving "repo-archive-admin-140665.txt" it was absent from the Record-filtered list. Filter, Show archived added its row marked Archived with a Restore action; Restore made it live again (read-back).

steps.action: Before you start: drag a live Contract Document row onto a Move to folder target inside its owning record
steps.expected: The Move to folder panel names the record's folders and the drop files the Document
steps.actual: Dragging the "repo-drag-admin-140665.txt" row showed the Move to folder panel for C-63 with None and "DOC-029r2 Admin Repo folder"; dropping on the folder filed the Document there (read-back).

steps.action: Archive a Document steps 1-3: Actions, Archive; it leaves the normal list; Show archived finds its Archived row
steps.expected: The Document leaves the list, reappears marked Archived, and keeps its Versions, files and designations
steps.actual: Archive removed "archive-main-admin-140665.docx" from the Documents list. Show archived drew its row with the Archived mark. Read-back: 3 Versions, still Primary, Executed pin on v2, and every Version download answered 200.

steps.action: Restore a Document steps 1-3: Show archived, Restore from the row Actions menu; Versions and designations come back
steps.expected: The Document is live again with its Versions, primary and executed-copy designation
steps.actual: Restore in the archived row's Actions menu made the Document live. With Show archived off its row read "archive-main-admin-140665.docx Primary Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline · theirs Redlin"; read-back kept 3 Versions, Primary, and the Executed pin on v2.

steps.action: Archive several live Documents with checkboxes and Archive; restore several archived Documents with Restore in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both leave the list together and return together
steps.actual: Selecting two live Documents and Archive in the selection bar removed both rows. With Show archived on, selecting both archived rows offered Restore, which made both live again (read-back).

steps.action: Restore a Document: refused while the owning record is archived; restore the record first
steps.expected: The archived record offers no Show archived or Document controls; restore is refused; after restoring the record the Document restores
steps.actual: While the Contract was archived, its Documents section showed no Show archived switch and no Upload (0); row menus offered only Compare with previous; restoring the archived Document was refused 409 ("This contract is archived. Restore it before changing its paper."). After the Contract was restored, Show archived and Restore made the Document live.

steps.action: Restore a Document: a stale-state message when someone already restored the same Document
steps.expected: Restore on a stale row shows a message; reloading shows the live Document
steps.actual: A second session restored the Document while this page still showed it archived. Restore on the stale row showed "This document is not archived.". After a reload the Document was live.

steps.action: Permanently delete steps 1-4: Actions, Delete; the dialog names the Document and Version count; Delete stays disabled until delete is typed; Cancel keeps it
steps.expected: Cancel and a wrong word leave the Document; the dialog text matches the guide
steps.actual: Delete opened "Delete this document?" reading "Delete this document? archive-main-admin-140665.docx and its 3 versions are removed, and the stored files with them. You cannot undo this. Type "delete" to confirm Cancel Delete". Delete stayed disabled with the field empty and with the Document name typed instead of the word. Cancel closed the dialog and the Document kept its 3 Versions.

steps.action: If deletion fails: a rename while the dialog is open makes OpenLaw refuse the deletion
steps.expected: The deletion is refused with a message and the Document stays
steps.actual: With the dialog open, a second request renamed the Document. Typing delete and selecting Delete was refused with "Type the document's name exactly to delete it."; the Document remained under its new name.

steps.action: Permanently delete: type delete, select Delete; every Version and the primary reference go; no other Document becomes primary; the activity record remains
steps.expected: The row is gone, Version downloads fail, no replacement primary, activity names the deletion
steps.actual: Typing delete enabled Delete; after it the row was gone (also with archived rows included). The three Version downloads answered 404, 404, 404. No remaining Document was marked Primary. The Contract activity read still named "archive-main-admin-140665.docx".

steps.action: Permanently delete: several Documents with checkboxes and Delete in the selection bar, also confirmed by typing delete
steps.expected: The bulk dialog asks for delete and removes both
steps.actual: Selecting two Documents and Delete in the selection bar opened "Delete 2 documents?" reading "Delete 2 documents? archive-del-2-admin-140665.txt archive-del-1-admin-140665.txt The selected documents and all their versions will be permanently deleted. Thi". Delete was disabled until delete was typed; then both Documents were removed.

steps.action: You cannot delete just one Version
steps.expected: No Version-level delete control; the seam has no single-Version delete
steps.actual: The earlier Version's menu offered Mark as executed copy: no Delete. A request to delete one Version answered 404; the Document kept both Versions.

steps.action: Archive a Document step 1: a Knowledge Item's Documents section archives and restores; it has Set as primary and no Document folders
steps.expected: Archive and Restore work in the Knowledge Documents section; Set as primary is offered; no New folder
steps.actual: The Knowledge Item's Documents section had no New folder button. The menu of a non-primary Document offered Set as primary, Add version, Edit details, Mark confidential, Archive, Delete (including Set as primary). Archive removed "knowledge-b-admin-140665.txt", Show archived showed it marked Archived, and Restore made it live again.

steps.expected: An upload message appears; the Version count stays the same
steps.actual: With a browser-network fixture answering 413 for the Version upload, the Add version dialog stayed open with the message "DOC-029 fixture: this file is larger than the upload limit.". The Document still had 3 Versions.

steps.action: File a Contract conversation attachment steps 1-4: File to Contract, New Document, Confidential preselected for Legal Only
steps.expected: A Legal Only attachment files as a new Confidential Document and the comment reads Filed to
steps.actual: The attachment offered File to Contract. File attachment opened with Destination New Document and "Confidential — restrict to the contract team" already on, plus Document name and Kind. File created "DOC-029r2 Legal filed paper 140665" (Confidential, one Version) and the comment read "Filed to DOC-029r2 Legal filed paper 140665, version 1".

steps.action: File a Contract conversation attachment: open the preview, File to Contract, New Version on an existing Document with a Note
steps.expected: The preview offers the same action; the Version is appended with its note
steps.actual: Selecting the attachment name opened its preview with Download and File to Contract. Choosing New Version on an existing Document, Document "DOC-029r2 Legal supply draft 140665" and a Note appended v4 with that note; the comment read "Filed to DOC-029r2 Legal supply draft 140665, version 4".

steps.action: File a Matter conversation attachment: File to Matter, no Kind, same Confidential switch label
steps.expected: The Matter offers File to Matter without Kind; filing creates a Matter Document
steps.actual: The Matter attachment offered File to Matter. File attachment had no Kind control and the switch read "Confidential — restrict to the contract team". File created the Matter Document.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders steps 1-2: New folder, Name, Save; an empty folder has no expand control
steps.expected: The folder row appears without an expand control
steps.actual: New folder opened a dialog with Name and Save. The "DOC-029r2 Legal Parent" row appeared reading "DOC-029r2 Legal Parent Empty" with no expand control.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 3: New subfolder and Rename from Actions for the … folder
steps.expected: The subfolder is created inside; the parent gains an expand control; Rename changes the name
steps.actual: New subfolder opened "New folder in DOC-029r2 Legal Parent"; the child appeared under the now-open parent (Collapse DOC-029r2 Legal Parent control present). Rename folder changed "DOC-029r2 Legal Child draft" to "DOC-029r2 Legal Child". Read-back: the child's parent is DOC-029r2 Legal Parent.

steps.action: Folder name rules: case-only duplicate sibling, blank name, slash, '.' and '..' are refused
steps.expected: Each attempt shows a refusal and creates nothing
steps.actual: All five names were refused in the dialog and no folder was created. "DOC-029R2 LEGAL PARENT": A folder named DOC-029R2 LEGAL PARENT is already here.; "   ": Give the folder a name.; "DOC-029 a/b": A folder name cannot contain a slash. Make a folder inside instead.; ".": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder.; "..": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder..

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 3: Move, Move into, None; a folder cannot move into itself or a descendant
steps.expected: Move into omits the folder and its descendant, the seam refuses a cycle, and None returns a folder to the top level
steps.actual: Move into for "DOC-029r2 Legal Parent" offered None, DOC-029r2 Legal Other: not the folder itself or its child. The seam refused a move into its own child (409: A folder cannot be moved inside itself.) and into itself (409). Moving "DOC-029r2 Legal Child" into "DOC-029r2 Legal Other" read back as DOC-029r2 Legal Other/DOC-029r2 Legal Child; Move into None put it at the top level.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: Move to folder, File in, Move; None moves it out
steps.expected: The Document is filed in the folder and then moved back to the record
steps.actual: Move to folder opened "Move doc029-legal-loose-a.txt" with File in; choosing "DOC-029r2 Legal Parent" filed the Document there and the folder gained an expand control showing it. File in None moved it back onto the record.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: drag a Document row onto a folder row, then onto Drop here to move out of folders
steps.expected: Dragging files the Document into the folder and back out
steps.actual: Dragging the "doc029-legal-loose-b.txt" row onto the "DOC-029r2 Legal Other" folder row filed it there (read-back). Dragging it from inside the folder showed "Drop here to move out of folders"; dropping on it moved the Document back to the record.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: select checkboxes and Move in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both selected Documents move into the chosen folder
steps.actual: Selecting both checkboxes showed "2 selected" with Move. The Move 2 documents dialog with File in "DOC-029r2 Legal Parent" filed both Documents there (read-back).

steps.action: Folder Delete dissolves the folder: contents move to its parent or the record, nothing is deleted
steps.expected: The confirmation says where contents go; the Documents stay live on the record
steps.actual: The confirmation read "Delete the DOC-029r2 Legal Parent folder? Anything in it moves onto the contract itself. Nothing is deleted. Cancel Delete". After Delete the folder was gone and both Documents were live at the record root.

steps.action: Import several files steps 1-5 with a partial failure: Destination Record root, Version kind, counts, Retry
steps.expected: The good files stay as v1 Documents, the failed row is named with Retry, and Retry sends only the failed file
steps.actual: Choose files with three files opened "Import 3 files" showing Destination Record root and Version kind ("Applied to every file in this import. Notes are not collected in bulk."). With a browser-network fixture answering 503 once for one file, the dialog read "Imported 2 of 3 files 2 of 3 files uploaded doc029-bulk-c.txt DOC-029 fixture: the upload service is unavailable. Retry doc029-bulk-a.txt Done doc029-bulk-b.txt Done 1 file failed. The other 2 are on the contract. Retry uploads the selected file again. Files o" with a row Retry and Retry 1 file. The two good files were already v1 Documents (Draft · theirs). Row Retry sent only the failed file and the dialog closed; the record gained exactly 3 Documents.

steps.action: Recover a partial import: a size refusal is not offered a retry; Done closes
steps.expected: The failed row has no Retry, and the good file remains
steps.actual: With a fixture answering 413 for one file, the dialog read "Imported 1 of 2 files 1 of 2 files uploaded doc029-bulk-d.txt DOC-029 fixture: this file is larger than the upload limit. doc029-bulk-a.txt Done 1 file failed. The other 1 is on the contract. Retry uploads the selected f" and offered no Retry control. Done closed it; the other file was on the record.

steps.action: Import step 5: when every file uploads the dialog closes after the list refreshes
steps.expected: The dialog closes by itself and both files are listed
steps.actual: A two-file import with no failure closed the dialog by itself; the record gained two Documents.

steps.action: Recover a partial import: Cancel remaining stops queued work and uploaded files remain
steps.expected: Queued files are cancelled; the finished uploads stay on the record; final counts are shown
steps.actual: With uploads slowed by a fixture, the running dialog said "Keep this dialog open until the import finishes." Cancel remaining settled it at "Imported 3 of 5 files": 2 file(s) read "Cancelled before it was uploaded." and the 3 uploaded file(s) were on the record (read-back +3).

steps.action: Keep a local folder structure: Choose folder keeps nested paths; the folder picker drops empty folders; a matching path is reused
steps.expected: The top-level folder and its nested child are created with their files; the empty folder is not; a second import reuses the path
steps.actual: Choose folder on a local tree (two files, one nested folder, one empty folder) opened "Import 2 files" reading "Import 2 files Destination Record root Folder structure is kept doc029-tree-140665 1 folder · 2 files sub-a 1 file doc029-nested.txt 23 byte doc029-top.txt 20 byte Version kind Draft · ours Draft · th". The import created doc029-tree-140665 and doc029-tree-140665/sub-a with the files; the empty folder was not created. Importing the same tree again reused the existing doc029-tree-140665 folder (still one).

steps.action: Import step 1-2 and Keep structure: drop files and a local folder on a folder row; the Destination is that folder; a dropped tree recreates empty folders
steps.expected: The Import dialog names the folder as Destination and the empty folder is recreated
steps.actual: Dropping the local tree on the "DOC-029r2 Legal Other" row opened a dialog reading "Import 2 files Destination DOC-029r2 Legal Other Folder structure is kept doc029-tree-140665 2 folders · 2 files empty-dir Empty sub-a 1 file doc029-nested.txt 23 byte doc029-top.txt 20 byte Version k". The import created DOC-029r2 Legal Other/doc029-tree-140665/sub-a and the empty DOC-029r2 Legal Other/doc029-tree-140665/empty-dir.

steps.action: Import step 3: a Matter import has no Version kind control
steps.expected: The Matter batch dialog shows Destination but no Version kind
steps.actual: On a Matter, Choose files with two files opened Import 2 files with Destination Record root and no Version kind control.

steps.action: Read a managed Document steps 1-4 (PDF): name opens the reader; v… indicator; Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in, Find in document; Download; Close the document
steps.expected: The reader shows the title and v1, the PDF controls work, Download returns the original bytes, and Close returns to the record
steps.actual: Selecting "legal-doc029-services-text.pdf" opened the reader "legal-doc029-services-text.pdf, version 1" with the v1 chip and Page 1 of 2. Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in and Find in document were present; Next page reached Page 2 of 2 and Previous page returned. Find for a word in the text layer read "1 of 2". Download returned the uploaded bytes (SHA-256 match). Close the document closed the reader.

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: Word and PowerPoint render as a PDF rendition; Download stays the uploaded file; a preview is not a new Version
steps.expected: Both open in the PDF reader after preparation and download the original bytes; the chain stays at one Version
steps.actual: legal-doc029-draft-v1.docx: rendition ready, PDF reader pages shown, download matched the uploaded file; legal-doc029-deck.pptx: rendition ready, PDF reader pages shown, download matched the uploaded file. Each chain still had one Version.

steps.action: Processing, scans: an image-only PDF stays a scan; Find has no match; OCR text arrives in the background; global search finds it
steps.expected: Reader Find reports no match, text read-back source is OCR, and global search lists the Document
steps.actual: The scan opened as Page 1 of 1 in the reader and Find in document for "Marrowbridge" read "No matches". The text read-back became ready from source ocr and contained the word. Global search for "Marrowbridge" listed "legal-doc029-scan.pdf".

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: PNG shows inline; EML shows headers, body and attachment list without remote images; a PDF attachment previews; a Word attachment downloads
steps.expected: Image inline; email headers and 2 attachments; no remote image request; PDF attachment opens; DOCX attachment is a download
steps.actual: The PNG drew as an inline image. The EML reader showed From, To, Subject, Date, the sandboxed "Message body" text and "2 attachments"; the body's remote image (src "") made no request to the remote host. The PDF attachment opened in a preview with "Back to the message"; the Word attachment was a download link and returned its bytes. Reading the email created no new Documents.

steps.action: Supported reading surfaces: other formats download from the name; a reader link shows the download-only card
steps.expected: CSV and ZIP names download directly; a reader link to one shows the card
steps.actual: Selecting "legal-doc029-schedule.csv" and "legal-doc029-bundle.zip" downloaded the original files (SHA-256 match) without opening a reader (0 -> 0 panels). Opening the CSV through a reader link showed "This file type does not open here. Download it to read it." with Download.

steps.action: Processing: Preparing this document for reading… while conversion is pending; the stored original is already downloadable
steps.expected: The pending message shows and Download returns the uploaded file
steps.actual: With a browser-network fixture holding the rendition read at pending, the reader showed "Preparing this document for reading…" and Download returned the uploaded Word file (SHA-256 match).

steps.action: Failed previews: the failure message, Download of the original, and recovery by adding a readable Version
steps.expected: A damaged Word file shows the failure card and downloads; a new Version renders while the failed Version stays in the chain
steps.actual: The malformed Word container reached rendition state failed. The reader showed "This file could not be prepared for reading here. Download it to read it." and Download returned the original bytes. Add version with a readable Word file made v2 (rendition ready), which opened in the PDF reader; expanding the chain and selecting the v1 filename still showed the failure card for v1.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 1: Documents from navigation; Recent shows up to five Documents by current-Version upload, not by opening
steps.expected: Recent lists at most five, in the order of the newest current Versions, and opening an older Document does not change it
steps.actual: The Documents navigation link opened the repository. Recent listed 5 Documents in the same order as the newest-current-Version read (repo-autodoc-legal-140665.docx, repo-knowledge-legal-140665.pdf, …). After opening the older "repo-folder-legal-140665.docx" and returning, Recent still matched the upload-time order and did not add it.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 2: Filter, Owner, Contracts/Matters/Entities/Auto-Docs/Knowledge, Apply
steps.expected: Owner offers the five kinds and each narrows to paper of that owner kind
steps.actual: Owner offered Contracts, Matters, Entities, Auto-Docs, Knowledge. Contracts: 50 rows, including repo-root-legal-140665.pdf; Matters: 50 rows, including repo-matter-legal-140665.pdf; Entities: 50 rows, including repo-entity-legal-140665.pdf; Knowledge: 19 rows, including repo-knowledge-legal-140665.pdf; Auto-Docs: 2 rows, including repo-autodoc-legal-140665.docx. Each list left out the fixture paper of the other owner kinds.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 3: Record with Search choices; Folder becomes available with Record root
steps.expected: Record narrows to one Contract; Folder picks the folder or Record root
steps.actual: Record with Search choices "C-89" narrowed the list to the Contract's 4 live Documents, and the Filter menu then offered Folder. Folder "DOC-029r2 Legal Repo folder" showed only "repo-folder-legal-140665.docx"; Record root showed the Documents outside folders. With Owner Knowledge, and with Owner Auto-Docs, the Filter menu offered no Folder.

steps.action: Search and narrow steps 4-5: Format and Uploader accept several values; different filters must all match; Uploaded From/To includes both dates; remove one filter and Clear all; Recent hides while filtered
steps.expected: Any-of within a filter, all-of across filters, inclusive dates, and Recent only without filters
steps.actual: On C-89, Format PDF + Word ("Matches any selected value") kept the PDF and the Word Document. Kind Draft · ours left out "repo-root-legal-140665.pdf", whose v1 is Draft · ours but whose current v2 is Draft · theirs. Kind Executed left only "repo-folder-legal-140665.docx"; Counterparty DOC-029r2 Legal Northwind 140665 and Uploader Nadia Haddad kept it. Uploaded From 2026-09-16 To 2026-09-16 ("Includes both dates") kept it; From 2026-09-17 showed "No documents match these filters.". Removing the Kind filter left the list empty; removing Uploaded widened it again. Recent was hidden while filters were active and returned after Clear all.

steps.action: Open the matching paper: selecting the name opens the owning record with the current Version; expand the chain for an earlier round
steps.expected: The record opens with the reader on v2 and the chain lists v1
steps.actual: Selecting "repo-root-legal-140665.pdf" opened C-89's Documents tab with the reader on "repo-root-legal-140665.pdf, version 2". Expanding the chain and selecting the earlier filename opened version 1.

steps.action: Missing or archived: a hidden record's Document does not appear through a filter or direct link
steps.expected: The Confidential Contract outside this reader's team is absent from Record choices and lists, and its address is refused
steps.actual: As Legal Team Member outside its team, Record choices for C-62 read "No matching choices", the repository read did not include its Document, the direct Documents read answered 404, and the address showed "C-62 does not exist, or you cannot open it. Back to Contracts".

steps.action: Missing or archived: Filter, Show archived includes archived Documents; the offered Restore brings one back
steps.expected: The archived row appears with Archived and Restore; Restore makes it live
steps.actual: After archiving "repo-archive-legal-140665.txt" it was absent from the Record-filtered list. Filter, Show archived added its row marked Archived with a Restore action; Restore made it live again (read-back).

steps.action: Before you start: drag a live Contract Document row onto a Move to folder target inside its owning record
steps.expected: The Move to folder panel names the record's folders and the drop files the Document
steps.actual: Dragging the "repo-drag-legal-140665.txt" row showed the Move to folder panel for C-89 with None and "DOC-029r2 Legal Repo folder"; dropping on the folder filed the Document there (read-back).

steps.action: Archive a Document steps 1-3: Actions, Archive; it leaves the normal list; Show archived finds its Archived row
steps.expected: The Document leaves the list, reappears marked Archived, and keeps its Versions, files and designations
steps.actual: Archive removed "archive-main-legal-140665.docx" from the Documents list. Show archived drew its row with the Archived mark. Read-back: 3 Versions, still Primary, Executed pin on v2, and every Version download answered 200.

steps.action: Restore a Document steps 1-3: Show archived, Restore from the row Actions menu; Versions and designations come back
steps.expected: The Document is live again with its Versions, primary and executed-copy designation
steps.actual: Restore in the archived row's Actions menu made the Document live. With Show archived off its row read "archive-main-legal-140665.docx Primary Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline · theirs Redlin"; read-back kept 3 Versions, Primary, and the Executed pin on v2.

steps.action: Archive several live Documents with checkboxes and Archive; restore several archived Documents with Restore in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both leave the list together and return together
steps.actual: Selecting two live Documents and Archive in the selection bar removed both rows. With Show archived on, selecting both archived rows offered Restore, which made both live again (read-back).

steps.action: Restore a Document: refused while the owning record is archived; restore the record first
steps.expected: The archived record offers no Show archived or Document controls; restore is refused; after restoring the record the Document restores
steps.actual: While the Contract was archived, its Documents section showed no Show archived switch and no Upload (0); row menus offered only Compare with previous; restoring the archived Document was refused 409 ("This contract is archived. Restore it before changing its paper."). After the Contract was restored, Show archived and Restore made the Document live.

steps.action: Restore a Document: a stale-state message when someone already restored the same Document
steps.expected: Restore on a stale row shows a message; reloading shows the live Document
steps.actual: A second session restored the Document while this page still showed it archived. Restore on the stale row showed "This document is not archived.". After a reload the Document was live.

steps.action: Before you start and Permanently delete: only an Administrator deletes; this role gets no Delete control and the seam refuses
steps.expected: No Delete in the row menu or selection bar; direct deletion is refused and the Document stays
steps.actual: The row menu offered Compare with previous, Mark as executed copy, Add version, Edit details, Move to folder, Mark confidential, Archive: no Delete. The selection bar had no Delete. A direct deletion answered 403; the Document kept its 3 Versions.

steps.action: Archive a Document step 1: a Knowledge Item's Documents section archives and restores; it has Set as primary and no Document folders
steps.expected: Archive and Restore work in the Knowledge Documents section; Set as primary is offered; no New folder
steps.actual: The Knowledge Item's Documents section had no New folder button. The menu of a non-primary Document offered Set as primary, Add version, Edit details, Mark confidential, Archive (including Set as primary). Archive removed "knowledge-b-legal-140665.txt", Show archived showed it marked Archived, and Restore made it live again.

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: Documents section, select a name to read the current Version, download beside it
steps.expected: The reader opens the current Version and the download returns its bytes
steps.actual: On the Portal Contract, selecting "portal-chain-v1.pdf" opened the reader "portal-chain-v1.pdf, version 2" with the v2 chip and the converted pages. The download button beside it ("Download portal-chain-v1.pdf, version 2") returned the uploaded Word bytes.

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: … earlier versions lists earlier Versions; a filename reads that Version
steps.expected: The earlier Version opens in the reader and downloads
steps.actual: "1 earlier version" listed portal-chain-v1.pdf; selecting it opened "portal-chain-v1.pdf, version 1" in the reader, and its download returned the v1 bytes.

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: archived Documents and records outside your audience are not listed
steps.expected: The archived Document is absent; a Contract without team membership is not found
steps.actual: The archived "portal-archived.txt" was not in the Portal Documents list. A Contract without the Business User on its team showed "Contract not found" (read 404).

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: on your own Request, select a file under Attachments to download it
steps.expected: The Request attachment downloads with its original bytes
steps.actual: On R-54, the Attachments file portal-request-attachment.csv downloaded with its original bytes; no Document reader opened (0 reader controls).

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: a comment attachment name opens its preview with Download; Preview unavailable appears for a file with no preview
steps.expected: The PDF previews and downloads; a ZIP shows the unavailable message with Download; no filing action
steps.actual: In Comments, selecting portal-thread.pdf opened its preview (PDF pages) and Download returned the bytes. portal-thread.docx also opened as a converted preview and Download returned the original Word bytes. portal-thread.zip showed "Preview unavailable. You can download the original file." and Download returned the ZIP bytes. No File to Contract action was offered to the Business User.

steps.action: Read files in the Business Portal: Knowledge lists the primary Document first with Download beside each file and no preview or Version picker; an archived item is no longer available
steps.expected: Primary first; downloads return bytes; no reader; archived item unavailable
steps.actual: The Portal Knowledge page listed portal-knowledge-primary.pdf Download | portal-knowledge-first.txt Download: the primary Document first although it was uploaded second. Download returned its bytes; file names were plain text, not reader buttons. After Legal archived the item, the same address landed on /portal ("What do you need from Legal? Help with this page NDA request…") with no files.

steps.action: Before you start: the Portal does not grant access to the staff Documents repository
steps.expected: The staff repository address and its read are refused
steps.actual: Opening /documents as the Business User landed on /portal; the repository read answered 403.

steps.action: Before you start: Business Users on the team upload Documents and add Versions in the Portal, including a new Version of the primary Document
steps.expected: Upload documents creates a Document; Add version appends to the primary Document
steps.actual: Add version on the Primary Document "portal-chain-v1.pdf" opened Upload documents with Add as preset to that Document (New version of it); the upload appended v3. Upload documents with two files created two Documents at the record root (read-back by Legal).

steps.action: Before you start and Recover: Business Users cannot change designations, kinds or folders, archive or delete, and get no filing action
steps.expected: The Portal shows no such controls and the staff seams refuse them
steps.actual: The Portal Documents section offered none of Make primary, Mark as executed copy, Move to folder, Archive, Delete, New folder or Edit details. Direct attempts were refused: {"primary":403,"kind":403,"executed":403,"folder":403,"archive":403,"delete":403}. The Document stayed live and Primary.

steps.action: Before you start: Business Users upload several files at the record root but cannot create folders, move Documents or import a folder structure
steps.expected: No folder controls or folder picker in the Portal; folder and move seams refuse
steps.actual: Upload documents in the Portal offered Add as, a file drop zone, Kind and Note but no Choose folder or New folder. The folder create seam answered 403 and moving a Document into a folder answered 403; the staff folder read answered 403. The two-file Portal upload in the previous step landed at the record root.

steps.action: Before you start: Business Users cannot archive, restore or delete; they have no managed-Document deletion controls
steps.expected: No archive, restore or delete controls; the seams refuse
steps.actual: The Portal Documents section had no Archive, Restore, Delete or Show archived control. Restore answered 403, archive 403, delete 403; the archived Document stayed archived.
